item.title: Top 5 Methods to Create Dynamic Workflows in Airflow
item.description:
Problem

Can Airflow facilitate the creation of workflows where the number of tasks, labeled as B.*, is indeterminate until Task A completes? While subdags provide a certain level of flexibility, they typically require a predefined set of tasks established at DAG creation.

Could using DAG triggers provide a solution? If yes, an illustrative example would be appreciated.

I face a scenario where determining the number of Task B’s required for computing Task C is contingent upon the completion of Task A. Each Task B.* requires several hours for computation and cannot be consolidated.
